basis: The visual evidence from the Factory F production dashboard shows the production line starting at 3,500 in 2018 and ending at approximately 2,100 in 2023. This represents a net decrease in production over the 2018-2023 review period. Although the chart title reads 'Increasing Production', the plotted data is the authoritative record of the trend. The option 'Route to production decline response' corresponds to this observed net decrease.
